name: workbench-template
description: Workbench template plugins: a core plugin plus optional packs.

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: development flow for any workbench tree (metarepo or flat): a development flow with one approval gate, an approval ledger, file-based epic tickets and research skills, tiered review with a script+haiku verifier, gated review and debugging flows, verification hooks that tie every test run to the committed HEAD, per-task git worktrees with an epic integration worktree, deterministic plan execution, read-only diagnostic subagents, and destructive-command guardrails.

plugins.name: workbench-infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure pack for the workbench template: Kubernetes, Terraform and Helm diagnostic agents and chart drift checks. Requires the workbench core plugin.

plugins.name: workbench-observability
plugins.description: Observability pack for the workbench template: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki and Kubernetes health diagnostics. Requires the workbench core plugin.

plugins.name: workbench-secrets
plugins.description: Secrets pack for the workbench template: dotenv and SOPS secret handling guardrails. Requires the workbench core plugin.
